item.title: Federal Probe of Three California Districts Over Student Surveys
item.description: The U.S. Department of Education is investigating three California school districts following complaints that students were asked to disclose sexual orientation.

item.title: Deployed Mother Grants Daughter's Wish with Heartwarming Surprise
New England City Transformed by Refugees Now Faces Youth Gun Violence Crisis
item.description: Mohamed Muhumed says he fears for his life in Lewiston, Maine, where over 80% of gun violence incidents involve teenagers, many repeat offenders.

item.title: Iran Increases Efforts to Target Americans Abroad, US Intelligence Memo Warns
item.description: An intelligence memo sent to Marco Rubio reveals Iranian plots to kill Americans have reached advanced stages in the Middle East and other countries.
